title: The Best Writing Starter 3 Jumping OX

1.title: Dream Jobs
1.description: want to be / like to + verb; wants / likes with he and she.

questions.text: I want to be a musician.
I like to write songs.
She want to be a vet.
questions.explanation: Add -s with she: She wants to be a vet.

questions.text: Kelly wants to be a content creator.
He likes make videos.
questions.explanation: Use 'to': He likes to make videos.

questions.text: I want to be a artist.
questions.explanation: Use 'an' before a vowel sound: an artist.

questions.text: He like to try new foods.
questions.explanation: Add -s with he: He likes to try new foods.

questions.text: She's really good at it!

2.title: Tastes of Food
2.description: It has ... in it, so it's + taste.

questions.text: The pizza is delicious.
It has lemon in it, so it's sour.
It have pepper in it, so it's spicy.
questions.explanation: Use 'has' with it: It has pepper in it.

questions.text: The cupcakes are tasty.
The pasta are good.
questions.explanation: One dish: The pasta is good.

questions.text: They have chocolate in them, so they're sweet.
The hamburgers is good.
It has sugar in them, so it's sweet.
questions.explanation: It goes with 'it': It has sugar in it.

3.title: My Daily Routine
3.description: in the morning / at night; at + time, around + time.

questions.text: In the morning, I wake up at seven.
I eat breakfast at seven thirty.
I does my homework around three.
questions.explanation: Use 'do' with I: I do my homework.

questions.text: In the night, I write a diary.
questions.explanation: Say 'At night': At night, I write a diary.

questions.text: I take the school bus around eight twenty.
In afternoon, I come home at two.
I have dinner on seven.
questions.explanation: Times use 'at': I have dinner at seven.

questions.text: I go to sleep around ten.

4.title: Animals vs. Humans
4.description: ..., but humans ...; Both ... and humans can ...

questions.text: Fish have scales, but humans have skin.
Fish can't run, but humans can.
Both fish and humans can swim.
Fish lives in the water.
questions.explanation: Fish (many) live: Fish live in the water.

questions.text: Fish can't blink their eyes, but humans can't.
questions.explanation: Humans CAN blink: but humans can.

questions.text: Birds have feathers, but humans has skin.
Both birds and humans can sings.
Humans live on land.

5.title: Fun Time with My Family
5.description: When it's ..., we usually ... But sometimes, ...

questions.text: When it's snowy, we usually stay home.
We watch TV and eat cookies.
But sometimes, we go out and make a snowman.
When it's windy, we stays home.
questions.explanation: Use 'stay' with we: we stay home.

questions.text: We usually goes out.
questions.explanation: Use 'go' with we: We usually go out.

questions.text: Sometimes we takes a walk.
questions.explanation: Use 'take' with we: we take a walk.

questions.text: When it windy, we stay home.
We go on a picnic and eat sandwiches.

6.title: My Busy Weekend
6.description: I'm going to + verb; First, Second ... Finally.

questions.text: I'm going to play soccer.
First, I'm going to buy some books.
I'm going to went to a party.
questions.explanation: After 'going to' use the base verb: go.

questions.text: Finally, I'm going to walk my dog.
I going to see a movie.
questions.explanation: Add 'am': I'm going to see a movie.

questions.text: I'm going to helping around the house.
Second, I'm go to meet my friends.
questions.explanation: Say 'I'm going to meet my friends.'

questions.text: What a weekend!

7.title: Packing List
7.description: will / won't + verb; his and her.

questions.text: I will take my swimsuit and shorts.
I won't take my books.
She'll take her tablet to read e-books.
He will takes his drone.
questions.explanation: After will, no -s: He will take his drone.

questions.text: Dad will take her sunglasses.
questions.explanation: Dad = his: Dad will take his sunglasses.

questions.text: I won't takes my RC car.
questions.explanation: After won't, no -s: I won't take my RC car.

questions.text: Mom will take his sundress.
questions.explanation: Mom = her: Mom will take her sundress.

questions.text: I'll take my laptop to play video games.
I'll give a flower pot to Jenny.
I'll give gloves to Tom because the weather is very cold.
I'll give socks for Leo.
questions.explanation: Use 'to': I'll give socks to Leo.

questions.text: I'll gives a book to Jenny.
His mitt is too small.
I'll give a mitt to Jack because he mitt is too small.
questions.explanation: Use 'his': because his mitt is too small.

questions.text: She love drawing.
questions.explanation: Add -s with she: She loves drawing.

questions.text: Christmas is coming.
